mapper.insert: insert into order_ticket(order_id, order_item_id, ticket_id, qr_code, verify_code, status) values(#{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{ticketId}, #{qrCode}, #{verifyCode}, 'UNUSED')
mapper.select: select * from order_ticket where verify_code=#{verifyCode} for update
select * from order_ticket where qr_code=#{qrCode} for update
mapper.update: update order_ticket set status='USED', used_at=now(), verify_method=#{method} where id=#{id} and status='UNUSED'
mapper.select: select count(1) from order_ticket where order_id=#{orderId} and status='UNUSED'
select count(1) from order_ticket where order_id=#{orderId} and status='USED'
select * from order_ticket where order_id=#{orderId} order by id asc
mapper.update: update order_ticket set status='REFUNDED' where order_id=#{orderId} and status='UNUSED'
update order_ticket set ticket_id=#{ticketId} where order_id=#{orderId}
